summary.zh: 确认频率可调：inbox brief 增加 ask / digest / quiet 三种确认模式，nudge 增加 confirm 与 prompt_cooldown_hours 配置并在 stop 前先问 gate；文档补充 hook 路径的硬限制与模型自判路径的边界。
summary.en: Confirmation frequency is tunable: inbox brief gains the ask / digest / quiet confirmation modes, nudge gains the confirm and prompt_cooldown_hours settings and asks the gate before stop, and the docs state the hard limits of the hook path and the boundary of the model-judged path.
